name: Field of View ~400mm
description: MY-RADS specifies FOV of 400 mm for whole-body DWI coverage. (From the MY-RADS Myeloma Whole-Body MRI Guidelines schema.)
implementation:
pixel_spacing = value["PixelSpacing"].iloc[0]
columns = value["Columns"].iloc[0]
rows = value["Rows"].iloc[0]

fov_col = pixel_spacing[0] * columns
fov_row = pixel_spacing[1] * rows
fov_max = max(fov_col, fov_row)

if fov_max < 350:
    raise ValidationError(f"FOV too small for whole-body coverage. Found {fov_max:.0f} mm, expected ~400 mm")
if fov_max < 380 or fov_max > 420:
    raise ValidationWarning(f"FOV should be approximately 400 mm. Found {fov_max:.0f} mm")
